options.name: Semi-Open Plan
options.note: Apr 2024 concept, Plan 'B' (240424 Proposed Phase 2 Plan 'B'): open kitchen and dining around a 13-ft island; family room, three bedrooms and a pantry wall in their own rooms. Status: concept (unapproved).

options.name: Open Plan
options.note: Jan 2024 concept (240125 Proposed Phase 2 Remodel Plan): kitchen, dining, family room and a sitting/games area in one open space; pantry, new bath and two bedrooms on the east side. Status: concept (unapproved).

options.name: Open great room
options.label: Illustrative idea. Not designed or reviewed by an architect or engineer.
options.description: The front and middle main-level bedrooms open into the great room: one vaulted living, dining and kitchen space with new glass toward the street. 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, plus office.
options.note: Concept r42 (owner idea, 11/12/2026): remove the front and middle main-level bedrooms, keep the back bedroom and the hall bath; one cathedral room under the original gable with an exposed ridge beam; a 14-1/4 ft picture window and glazed gable on the street wall, a second north window. Status: illustrative, not designed or reviewed by an architect or engineer.

options.name: Open kitchen and great room
options.label: Illustrative idea. Not designed or reviewed by an architect or engineer.
options.description: The two bedrooms open into one vaulted great room with the kitchen at the street end, a fireplace, skylights and a folding glass wall to a new front deck; the old kitchen becomes a reading nook. 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, plus office.
options.note: Concept r42b (owner idea, 11/12/2026): as "Open great room", but the kitchen moves to the street end (island facing the room), the old kitchen is taken out and becomes a reading nook with a window seat (r43), the picture window becomes a folding glass wall onto an extended front deck, a gas fireplace on the north wall, four skylight wells. Status: illustrative, not designed or reviewed by an architect or engineer.
